sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 20% for 60 seconds.
All stats reduction effect boosted by 5% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the value of the Wind element weakening effect on monsters is increased by 10%.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7000
